source: Hatsopoulos & Gyftopoulos (1973/1979) Thermionic Energy Conversion Vol. I & II, MIT Press; Rasor (1991) IEEE Trans. Plasma Sci. 19(6) 1191-1208; Angrist (1982) Direct Energy Conversion

unit.name: Cesium-vapor thermionic diode — physics-lumped emitter thermal model

phi_emitter_0.note: Emitter (hot electrode) work function at T0 (Cs/O-coated W)

phi_collector_0.note: Collector (cool electrode) work function at T0 (Cs-coated)

space_charge_factor.note: Net output-current reduction from space-charge / plasma barrier (~0.7-0.95 for Cs ignited mode)

plasma_drop_V.note: Arc/plasma voltage drop in ignited Cs discharge subtracted from output

lead_resistance_ohm.note: External lead + contact resistance (10 uohm; high-current electrode delivers ~1000s A)

emitter_heat_capacity.note: Lumped emitter thermal mass m*cp (refractory emitter block)

T_collector_default.note: Collector held at fixed sink temperature

Q_external_default.note: Default external heat power delivered to emitter (combustion/solar/nuclear)
